notes_for_editor: Identity rests on one source, the Forest Lookouts page, which gives only the name and county. The record coordinates (30.7267, -85.5359) come from the Forest Lookouts index and were not confirmed on any page read here. Unverified lead, not used in the story: a Florida Memory item titled 'Florida Forest Service building and fire observation tower' (item 326330) came up in search but returned 403, so it is unknown whether it concerns this tower. anyplaceamerica directory pages also returned 403. Next step, if wanted: a manual check of Florida Memory or Florida Forest Service records.
